info.title: Teamwork API
info.description: Team and work management API. Contract at docs/API.md.

post.description: Answers using project and task records the caller is authorized to see. This endpoint does not index source code or uploaded archives.
Creates the first workspace owner, or a member when open registration is enabled.
Returns short-lived access and refresh JWTs.
Revokes the presented session and issues a new token pair.
Revokes the current refresh session when refresh_token is supplied.
Creates a workspace and grants the creator owner access.

get.description: Lists active workspaces the caller belongs to.

patch.description: Updates a workspace name, slug, or description. Requires owner or admin role.

get.description: Lists people and workspace roles. Only workspace members can view the list.

post.summary: Add an existing user to a workspace
post.description: Adds an active account by email. Workspace owners/admins may add members or guests; only owners may grant the admin role.

post.summary: Create a user account and add it to a workspace
post.description: Creates an account with an initial password and adds it to the workspace. Only workspace owners/admins may do this; only owners may grant admin.

get.description: Returns the unread in-app notification count for the current user.
Returns whether web push is configured and the public VAPID key for this browser.

post.description: Registers or updates a push destination for the authenticated user's browser.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user's browser push destination.

get.description: Lists the current user's notifications, newest first.

patch.description: Marks one of the current user's notifications as read.

post.description: Marks all unread notifications belonging to the current user as read.
Creates a team inside a workspace. Owner/admin access required.

get.description: Lists workspace teams for a workspace member.

post.description: Creates a project and its default workflow.

get.description: Lists active projects in the workspace.

post.description: Creates a project task with an auto-incremented project key.

get.description: Lists paginated tasks. Supports status and assignee filters.

patch.description: Updates allowed task fields and emits a task event after commit.

delete.description: Moves a task to trash; workspace admin or editor access is required.

get.description: Lists status transitions and their handoff notes for workspace members.
Liveness endpoint; does not require authentication.
Checks database connectivity before accepting traffic.
Lists public channels and private channels the caller can access.

post.description: Creates a workspace channel. Members may create; guests can read existing channels.

patch.description: Channel creator and workspace owners/admins can edit its name and description.

delete.description: Soft deletes a channel. The creator or workspace owners/admins can archive it.

post.summary: Add a member to a private channel
post.description: Only the channel creator or a workspace owner/admin can add workspace members.

get.description: Lists private-channel members or all workspace members for a public channel.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a private channel
delete.description: The channel creator or workspace owner/admin can remove a private-channel member.

get.description: Returns chronological messages or replies for a root message, with pagination.

post.description: Creates a message or a one-level threaded reply.

patch.description: The author or a workspace owner/admin can edit a message.

delete.description: Soft deletes a message. The author or workspace owner/admin can delete it.

get.description: Lists active Markdown documents in the workspace.

post.description: Creates a Markdown document and its initial version; members can create documents.

get.description: Returns Markdown content for a document visible in the caller's workspace.

patch.description: Saves document content as a new immutable version.

delete.description: Soft deletes a document. The author or workspace owner/admin can archive it.
